proof_summary: If $F_{33}$ is prime, its totient is $2^{2^{33}}$, and every smaller positive integer has totient too small, so it is minimal. Otherwise, a smaller witness than $2^{2^{33}+1}$ would have totient exactly $2^{2^{33}}$; even witnesses contradict $2\varphi(m)\le m$, while an odd witness has distinct Fermat-prime divisors whose $2$-adic totient contributions must sum to $2^{33}$, impossible without the index-$33$ contribution since all lower distinct powers sum to only $2^{33}-1$.
